name: Importing usage produces an exact bill

planSteps.description: Open the app and wait for the initial solve to finish.
In 'Your own usage', click 'Use a sample'.
Verify the textarea fills with rows beginning 'timestamp,kwh' followed by ISO-8601 timestamps.
Click 'Bill this usage' and wait for the result.
Verify a panel titled 'Your usage, on this tariff' appears with a dollar total, alongside a panel titled 'What the parser read' showing Intervals read of 20 and Outside the horizon of 0.
Verify the energy metered in the parser panel equals the sum of the energies across the bill's lines.
